name: Google Sheets
hint: A web OAuth client in your Google Cloud project with the Google Sheets API enabled, and one account’s refresh token for this scope under https://www.googleapis.com/auth/: spreadsheets, for example from the OAuth 2.0 Playground; an External app left in Testing gets tokens that end after 7 days.

pick.name: get_spreadsheet
pick.says: Returns a spreadsheet’s title, locale and time zone, and each sheet’s properties, formatting and protected ranges, with no cell data unless fields asks for it. Without fields the answer can be large: fields=sheets.properties(sheetId,title) lists the sheets. ranges takes one range in A1 notation, for example Sheet1!A1:D20, and keeps only the parts of the spreadsheet that intersect it. spreadsheetId is in the spreadsheet’s address: docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/SPREADSHEET_ID/edit.

pick.name: get_values
pick.says: Returns the values of a range in A1 notation, for example Sheet1!A1:D20 or 'Q3 Sales'!A:C (quote a sheet name with spaces); empty trailing rows and columns are left out. valueRenderOption is FORMATTED_VALUE (the default), UNFORMATTED_VALUE or FORMULA, and dateTimeRenderOption is SERIAL_NUMBER (the default) or FORMATTED_STRING.

pick.name: create_spreadsheet
pick.says: Creates a spreadsheet in the root folder of the account’s Google Drive and returns it, with its spreadsheetId and spreadsheetUrl. Body: {"properties": {"title": "Budget 2027"}}.

pick.name: update_values
pick.says: Writes values into a range in A1 notation, for example Sheet1!A1:D20. valueInputOption is required: USER_ENTERED reads each value as if typed into Sheets (formulas, dates, numbers), RAW stores it as it is. Body: {"values": [["A1", "B1"], ["A2", "B2"]]}.

pick.name: append_values
pick.says: Appends rows after the table of data found in a range in A1 notation; Sheet1 searches the whole sheet. valueInputOption is required (USER_ENTERED or RAW); by default the rows overwrite what follows the table, and insertDataOption=INSERT_ROWS inserts new rows instead. Body: {"values": [["Ada", "2027-01-31", 42]]}.
